title.narrative: Empowering TVET Managers through Capacity Building for Institutional Transformation and Sustainable Development in Pakistan

description.narrative:
The TVET Sector Support Programme, commissioned by BMZ and co-funded by the EU, aims to build the capacity of 300 TVET managers in Pakistan in partnership with UNESCO-UNEVOC. The project will enhance management skills, foster effective leadership, and advance the TVET sector through a series of targeted interventions. By equipping TVET managers with the tools to implement sustainable change, the programme will contribute to a more dynamic and efficient TVET system.
The project outcomes focus on improved leadership and management practices, effective change management, stronger industry-academia linkages, and enhanced policy implementation within TVET institutions. The programme's six key outputs include enhanced leadership skills, better management practices, strengthened collaboration between industry and academia, and the development of practical action plans for institutional reform.
The project activities include a comprehensive needs assessment to tailor training content, development of customized training materials, and the establishment of an online learning platform. A blend of virtual and onsite training will be provided through webinars, self-paced online courses, and onsite workshops tailored to different management levels. Continuous feedback collection and evaluation will be carried out to monitor the impact and effectiveness of the programme, ensuring that the interventions translate into tangible improvements. Ultimately, this capacity-building initiative aims to empower TVET managers to lead the transformation of Pakistan’s TVET sector, contributing to sustainable workforce development and economic growth.
